artist.name: Jay Drive
artist.bio: Jay Drive is a New Delhi DJ who plays electro, house, minimal and techno, with over a decade behind the decks. He has been a resident and programmer at Auro and Summerhouse, opened for Helena Hauff in New Delhi in 2025, and played Magnetic Fields Nomads 2026.

eras.sound: Electro and house, leaning into acid grooves
